VeloFlame

Velocity-based proxy focused on performance and protection against bot attacks.

Network

Official websiteView on BuiltByBit

What it does

VeloFlame is a Velocity-based proxy focused on performance and protection against bot attacks, with tags velocity, proxy, anti-bot and performance. It covers the same job as the Bungee-side proxy in this set on the modern Velocity platform, and the tags split the reason in two: performance for the connections that should pass, anti-bot for the ones that should not. Both are proxy concerns, which is why it is filed under Network.
